text_version.note: Full law stored; the relevant provision is Article 35 in the JORF numbering (Titre VII), which inserts I bis in art. L. 300-6-2 Code de l'urbanisme (data centres qualifiable by decree as projet d'intérêt national majeur; permit may be refused where structural water stress; data-centre definition) and in its V lets the energy minister ask RTE to reserve grid connection capacity for electricity-intensive industrial/digital projects; its IV was censured. Registry number/date/title match the JORF. Note: the JORF visa reads 'décision du Conseil constitutionnel n° 2026-903 DC du 21 mars 2026' while the censure notes and the travaux préparatoires say 21 mai 2026 (apparent slip in the visa; registry's 21 May is consistent with the body). 84 articles. Raw HTML assembled by script from the official DILA JORF open-data XML (texte/version + texte/struct + section_ta + article files) downloaded with curl from echanges.dila.gouv.fr (Légifrance itself returns 403 to curl); article order and headings follow the JORF struct file; no text altered.

territorial_scope.description: Applies across French territory: the state qualifies projects by decree, local permit authorities decide permits, and the energy minister acts for projects located on national territory.

evidence.quote: Pour l'implantation sur le territoire de projets d'infrastructures industrielles et numériques fortement consommatrices en électricité

summary.short: French omnibus simplification law (Loi n° 2026-403). Article 35 lets a decree qualify data centres as projets d'intérêt national majeur, lets permit authorities refuse data-centre building permits in water-stressed areas, and lets the energy minister ask the transmission operator to reserve grid capacity for electricity-intensive digital projects.
summary.long: Loi n° 2026-403 of 26 May 2026 is a broad simplification statute covering administration, business formalities, public procurement, commerce, insurance, health research and other areas. This annotation covers its AI-relevant provisions, which sit in Article 35 (Titre VII) and, for the data-protection regulator, Article 59. Article 35 I.3°b inserts a new paragraph I bis into Code de l'urbanisme L. 300-6-2: a data centre of particular importance for the digital or ecological transition or national sovereignty may be qualified by decree as a projet d'intérêt national majeur. The same paragraph allows the administrative authority to refuse a data-centre building permit where the territory faces structural water-resource tensions, and defines a data centre. Article 35 V allows the energy minister to ask the public transmission operator to reserve connection capacity for electricity-intensive industrial and digital projects, and allows the operator to charge an additional contribution to cover operating measures, with calculation principles subject to approval by the energy regulator (CRE). Article 35 IV is marked as declared unconstitutional by the Conseil constitutionnel decision cited in the text. Article 59 requires the CNIL to promote innovation in artificial intelligence when using its instruments and in its missions. The text gives no general sanction regime for these provisions.

notes: Relations cover the whole law (all titles), not only the data-centre article. The data-centre provisions are Art. 35 I 3° b (new I bis of L. 300-6-2 of the urban planning code, which allows a decree to qualify a data centre as a project of national major interest and allows refusal of a building permit in water-stressed areas) and Art. 35 V (grid capacity reservation). Art. 35 IV is marked as struck down by the Conseil constitutionnel and is not coded. Many articles carry the bracketed note 'Dispositions déclarées non conforme à la Constitution' and their text is not coded. Inconsistency: the preamble cites decision n° 2026-903 DC 'du 21 mars 2026', while the bracketed notes and the publication note give 'du 21 mai 2026'. The relations list is not exhaustive: minor amendments and repeals in other codes (e.g. code de la défense, code de l'éducation, code des transports, code de la sécurité sociale, code rural, code de la route) are not individually recorded. Art. 35 V cites L. 342-12 of the energy code, recorded under the energy code amendment row. target_instrument_id is left empty because no registry IDs were supplied.
